english: <primary/>Primary Weapon Kills grant Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds. Destroying <link Constructs [#CombatantClassifications] /> and other destroyable entities with a <primary/>Primary Weapon also activates the buff.

source.text:
4 Piece | Gift of Sight

Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds.

Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
